method: Three pairs at matching output times, with before/after labels concealed until these observations were saved. Review used 2048x1152 previews of 5312x2988 decoded frames.
criteria: Visible decode corruption, orientation, framing, clarity. This does not assess motion continuity, music, the complete film, or equivalent source windows.

pairs.observation: A has more foreground activity and visible motion softness. B shows a clearer open path. Both frames are intelligible; no decode corruption is visible. Different source moments prevent a like-for-like sharpness conclusion.
A is an open landscape; B is a park scene with a partially cropped sculpture. Both are technically usable. The different scenes demonstrate an editorial timing change, not equivalent images.
Both landscape frames have similar readable detail, natural color and usable framing. No material technical defect is apparent in either preview.

conclusion: No obvious decoding or orientation failure in these six samples. This small qualitative check cannot prove unchanged editorial quality.
